summary: EmploymentApplicationDocument handles the storage, retrieval, validation, and deletion of documents associated with employment applications. It provides workflows to upload, categorize, display, and remove documents such as resumes (anonymous and named), photos, and user-defined documents. The system includes rules for displaying document metadata, handling anonymous/named status, and ensuring required information is present.
purpose: To enable management of documents (upload, display, categorize, remove) related to employment applications. Documents are linked to applicants and categorized by type, with support for anonymous/named distinction and user-defined documents. The module includes validation, business rules, and system behaviors for document lifecycle and access.

fields.name: TypeCodeID
fields.description: Document type code (resume-named, resume-anon, photo, etc.)

fields.name: FileURL
fields.description: Public URL to access the document

fields.name: ByUserID
fields.description: ID of the user who last updated

fields.name: UpdatedDetails
fields.description: Details of update (date, by whom, agency)

workflows.name: Get Employment Application Documents
steps: Search for documents by EmploymentApplicationID and document type code.
Fill document list with relevant data from database.
If special (e.g., anonymous resume, photo) and none found, create placeholder document.
For user-defined documents, append details such as anonymous/named, updated details.

workflows.name: Upload/Add Employment Application Documents
steps: Pass parameters: SessionID, EmploymentApplicationID, StudentDocumentIDList, AddWebPage.
Retrieve file paths from added documents.

workflows.name: Delete Employment Application Document
steps: Delete file and containing folder from filesystem (ignore exceptions).

business_rules: FileURL and FilePath must not be blank for validity.
Anonymous documents are removed if StaffID equals StudentID.
Named/anonymous and user-defined documents are treated with magic numbers in placeholder cases.
TypeCode may be adjusted with comments and named/anonymous flags.
validations: File existence checked before rendering URL as a link.
Update date checked for update details.
calculations: UpdatedDetails composed from update date, name, and agency.
conditions: If no document present for expected type (anon/named/photo), create empty placeholder.
If StaffID equals StudentID, remove anonymous docs from list.
system_behavior: Retrieves and populates document entities from database.
Deletes files and folders from filesystem on document delete.
Displays document with full metadata and update details.
Handles localization and alternate language fields.
dependencies: HSPnetSession for context and DB access.
exceptions: File/folder deletion: exceptions ignored if unable to delete.
Validation errors: session messages record and return false from IsValid.
content_gaps: Exact UI actions and error handling details are not fully described.
Specifics on permission checks, document visibility rules, and full business exceptions are incomplete.
Descriptions of placeholder document creation (magic numbers) refer to comments rather than explicit code.
